payload.meta_title: Symbolic Ceremony Meaning and How to Marry Legally Too
payload.meta_description: What a symbolic ceremony is, how it differs from a legal wedding, and how Australian couples marry legally at home and celebrate anywhere in the world.

outline.answers: symbolic ceremony; what is a symbolic wedding; symbolic ceremony meaning (related search in Melbourne, Dubai, New York)
outline.notes: 40 to 60 word answer first: a ceremony with no legal effect. Mention commitment ceremony and blessing as other names. Vow renewal is the already-married version (link /expert-advice/vow-renewal-ideas).

outline.h2: How Do You Marry Legally and Still Have a Symbolic Ceremony?
outline.answers: marry legally in australia then abroad (no measurable volume, but the core user intent); symbolic wedding abroad
h3: Hold the legal ceremony after you return
outline.notes: AGD: NOIM at least 1 month and no more than 18 months ahead; Australian celebrants cannot perform overseas marriages. Smartraveller: overseas marriages cannot be registered in Australia but are usually recognised. One line on NOIM; link the NOIM page only once it is live (currently 404). Link /destination-weddings/get-married-in-new-zealand as a worked example.
